import re

VAR = re.compile(r'^(?P<name>[^\s:=][^:=]*?):(?P<type>[A-Z]+)=(?P<value>.*)$')
HELP = re.compile(r'^//\s?(?P<help>.*)$')

def parse(lines):
    records = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    help_parts = []
    help_idx = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        s = line.rstrip()
        if not s.strip():
            continue
        if s.startswith('-- '):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = HELP.match(s)
        if m:
            help_parts.append(m.group('help').strip())
            help_idx.append(i)
            continue
        m = VAR.match(s)
        if m:
            records.append({'Name': m.group('name'), 'Type': m.group('type'), 'Value': m.group('value'), 'Help': ' '.join(p for p in help_parts if p)})
            used.extend(help_idx)
            used.append(i)
            help_parts = []
            help_idx = []
            continue
    blocks = []
    if records:
        blocks.append({'name': 'cache_entries', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': records})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
